metadata.title: Startup Resilience with Exponential Backoff (postgres and redis)
metadata.author: crivetimihai

description:
Closes #2025

## Summary

- Add exponential backoff with jitter for database and Redis connection retries at startup
- Increase default retry attempts from 3 to 30 (~5 minutes total wait time)
- Prevent CPU-intensive crash-respawn loops when dependencies are temporarily unavailable

## Problem

When PostgreSQL or Redis is temporarily unavailable during startup (network blip, rolling restart, slow container initialization), the Gateway workers would:

1. Retry only 3 times with fixed 2-second intervals (6 seconds total)
2. Exit after exhausting retries
3. Get respawned immediately by Granian (`--respawn-failed-workers`)
4. Repeat the cycle, causing **500%+ CPU usage** from rapid crash-respawn loops

## Solution

Implement exponential backoff with jitter in both `db_isready.py` and `redis_isready.py`:

- **Backoff formula**: `min(interval * 2^(attempt-1), 30s)` - doubles each attempt, capped at 30 seconds
- **Jitter**: ±25% randomization prevents thundering herd when multiple workers retry simultaneously
- **Default retries**: Increased from 3 to 30 (~5 minutes total before worker exits)

### Retry Progression Example

| Attempt | Base Backoff | With Jitter (±25%)  |
|---------|--------------|---------------------|
| 1       | 2s           | 1.5s – 2.5s         |
| 2       | 4s           | 3s – 5s             |
| 3       | 8s           | 6s – 10s            |
| 4       | 16s          | 12s – 20s           |
| 5+      | 30s (cap)    | 22.5s – 37.5s       |

Note: The 30s cap applies to the base backoff; jitter is applied after, so actual sleep times can range from 22.5s to 37.5s at the cap.

## Test Plan

- [x] Normal startup with all dependencies available
- [x] PostgreSQL late startup (30+ seconds delay)
- [x] Redis late startup (30+ seconds delay)
- [x] SQLite mode (no external database)
- [x] Memory cache mode (no Redis)

## Files Changed

### Core Implementation
- `mcpgateway/utils/db_isready.py` - Add exponential backoff with jitter, skip sleep on final attempt
- `mcpgateway/utils/redis_isready.py` - Add exponential backoff with jitter (already skipped sleep on final attempt)
- `mcpgateway/config.py` - Update default retries from 3 to 30

### Configuration
- `docker-compose.yml` - Add retry configuration with documentation
- `.env.example` - Update defaults and add explanatory comments
